capabilities: Render Slack mrkdwn in slack code blocks
Show workspace custom emoji with picker suggestions
Copy notes and selections as Slack-ready text
Import Slack threads as blocks or callouts
Post notes to Slack channels or threads
disambiguation: Not a Slack theme or appearance plugin; it renders Slack mrkdwn and custom emoji inside notes.
extras: Posting to Slack is off by default and needs the chat:write scope; tokens are kept in Obsidian's secret storage, and emoji images are cached in the plugin folder for offline use. README also has a Japanese section.
problem: Slack messages drafted in Obsidian show raw mrkdwn and no workspace emoji, and there is no built-in way to pull a Slack thread into a note or paste a note into Slack with correct formatting.

relations.evidence: Copy as Slack text. Turn a note or selection into mrkdwn that formats correctly when pasted into Slack.

summary: Renders Slack mrkdwn in slack code blocks with workspace custom emoji, imports Slack threads, and copies notes as Slack-ready text.
